meta.title: MacleanFy — a free, open source Mac cleaner
meta.description: Free up space on your Mac knowing exactly what will go. A free, open source graphical cleaner based on mac-cleaner-cli.
hero.title.1: Free up space on your Mac
hero.text: MacleanFy shows what is filling your disk, sorts it by risk level and deletes only what you confirm. Free and open source.
hero.note: macOS 12 or later · MIT License · version
hero.which: Not sure? Open the Apple menu → About This Mac: a “Chip” line means Apple Silicon, a “Processor” line means Intel.
hero.shot: MacleanFy overview screen, with disk health and reclaimable space
features.title: What it does
features.overview.title: Overview
features.overview.text: Disk health, reclaimable space by group and what you have already freed, on one screen.
features.performance.title: Performance now
features.performance.text: Live processor, memory, disk, network and battery, why your Mac may be slow and what runs on its own in the background.
features.clean.title: Cleaning in 17 categories
features.clean.text: Caches, logs, development leftovers, browsers, old downloads, large files and duplicates.
features.uninstall.title: Uninstaller
features.uninstall.text: Lists each app with what it left in your Library and the services it installed in the system, and removes it all together. You can keep the settings to reinstall later.
features.maintenance.title: Maintenance
features.maintenance.text: Flushes the DNS cache, rebuilds Quick Look thumbnails, reindexes Spotlight and deletes local Time Machine snapshots.
features.updates.title: Updates
features.updates.text: Tells you when a new version is out, downloads it only if you ask and installs it when the app restarts.
shots.clean: Smart cleaning screen, with the categories and the risk level of each one
shots.clean.caption: Every category shows its risk level. Open one to pick item by item.
safety.title: Built not to delete what it shouldn't
safety.text: A cleaner deletes files. These are the guards.
safety.read.title: Scanning only reads
safety.read.text: Nothing leaves the disk before you review the list and confirm.
safety.preselect.title: Only the safe is pre-selected
safety.preselect.text: Anything moderate or risky waits for your choice, and risky items ask for an extra confirmation.
safety.dry.title: You can do a dry run
safety.dry.text: The dry run option walks through everything without deleting.
safety.system.title: The system is off limits
safety.system.text: Paths like /System and /usr are refused and never even listed.
safety.trash.title: Uninstalling is reversible
safety.trash.text: Apps go to the Trash, where you can put them back.
safety.note: Cleaning a category is permanent: files do not go through the Trash.
install.title: Install
install.step1: Download the installer for your Mac and open the .dmg file.
install.step2: Drag MacleanFy to the Applications folder.
install.step3: Open the app. The installer is signed and notarized by Apple: the first time, macOS only asks you to confirm opening an app downloaded from the internet.
install.checksum: To check your download, the release page lists the SHA-256 of each file.
based.title: Based on mac-cleaner-cli
based.text: MacleanFy's scanners and safety rules come from mac-cleaner-cli by guhcostan, released under the MIT license. MacleanFy adds the graphical interface. If you prefer the terminal, use the original project.
support.title: Support the project
support.text: MacleanFy is free and open source. If it helped you, a contribution keeps the project going.
